response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM grouped) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(b.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is CPU usage minus GPU usage for each record.
A zero mean group storage makes the ratio NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: The CPU–GPU usage gap is the absolute difference in usage.
